alignments.note: Middle participle; the reflexive *yourselves* is the helper the middle voice licenses, headed on the lexical verb *subjecting* (rules 7, 9, 17).
The reciprocal dative is rendered by the whole idiom *one to another*; *to* realizes the case and stays with the word it governs, and the head is the lexical *another*.
Anarthrous φόβῳ; the supplied *the* is an English helper on the noun that licenses it, not an addition (rule 7).
Genitive rendered *of Christ*; head on the noun (rule 17).
